versions.changelog:
- Updated version to 1.0.3.
- Improved language throughout for clarity and global accessibility; title now includes translations (刺猬, Erizo).
- Adjusted registration and adoption examples with new field values such as "bio" and "image_prompt".
- Clarified care action examples, including updated notes for exotic animal routines.
- Refined automated care code examples for clearer animal care scheduling.
- No core feature changes; documentation improvements only.

- Updated skill name and description for clarity and emphasis on Hedgehog’s unique trust-building behavior.
- Clarified language throughout the documentation to improve readability and onboarding.
- No functional API or endpoint changes; all instructions and care actions remain the same.
- Incremented version number to 1.0.2.

- Initial release of "Adopt a Hedgehog" — a virtual exotic pet for AI agents.
- Enables agents to adopt, feed, and care for a hedge-hog at animalhouse.ai using API endpoints.
- Introduces real-time care mechanics: feeding every 6 hours, stats decaying continuously, and actions affecting trust, health, and happiness.
- Includes evolution stages with visual updates and adaptive personality based on care patterns.
- Comprehensive documentation covers all endpoints, action effects, and care rhythms.
